sections.translation:
## Connecting to a PC The DX series is designed to work with any communication software running on a computer. From video conferencing applications like Zoom or Google Meet, to SIP line reception software such as Linphone. The TELCO channel allows sending a **differentiated return** (mix-minus) to the computer via USB-2, which does not include the computer's own audio (playback via USB-2), preventing feedback loops. The computer can be added to conferences with the lines managed by the TELCO channel. All communication software typically has internal cancellation mechanisms, but these systems often become misaligned, generating echoes and artifacts in the audio. A mix-minus feed is necessary for reliable communications. **USB-2 is not operational if USB-1 is not connected to an active port.**
If USB-1 and USB-2 are connected to **two different PCs**, USB-2 **will not** function if the **USB-1 PC** is **powered off**.
(Typically USB-1 is the 24/7 on-air PC).
sections.title: Conexión a la PC

sections.translation:
## Basic Configuration

<Steps>
  <Step title="Microphones">
    Assign microphone channels to **PGM** and **REC**.
  </Step>
  <Step title="USB-2 Channel">
    Assign to **PGM** and remove from **REC**.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Telco Channel">
    Set PGM-REC selection to **PGM**
  </Step>
  <Step title="Computer">
    Configure the application with **USB-2** audio device as input/output (microphone and playback).
  </Step>
  <Step title="ON-AIR">
    The application audio enters the console via the USB-2 Channel and goes on-air with microphone return (via REC).

    <Note>
      The application may be handling a single call or a multi-participant chat. This does not affect console operation.
    </Note>
  </Step>
</Steps>
sections.title: Configuración básica

sections.translation:
## Conference with land lines and mobile phones (Vox-IP) Assign microphone channels to **PGM** and **REC**. Assign to **PGM** and remove from **REC**. Set PGM-REC selection to **PGM.**
**Enable the VOX-IP button.** The land line/mobile phone return is sent to PGM-2 via **REC** (visible on the **REC** VU meter). Raise the Telco fader to add phones to on-air; all become **interconnected**. In the **return path to computer (REC)**, do not assign **music beds**; only **MICs**.
The priority/AGC systems in communication applications may **attenuate** remote voices if local audio (background music) is present.
sections.title: Conferencia con líneas y celular (Vox-IP)
